name: Expert
title: Expert
clues: Boisterous Baboon: "I like to be heard. Put me in the enclosure that is next to at least half of the other animals."
Bathing Baboon: "I want to be alone in my space, without Jungle or Grass."
Brash Baboon: "I'm a monkey who will only share my space with monkeys. I want to be next to exactly 2 different enclosure types."
Baby Baboon: "I'm little and want to play! Put me in the Jungle with 1 Monkey and 1 Ape."
Benevolent Baboon: "I don't want any other Baboons in Sand. But I want all Baboons to be next to another Baboon."
Gorilla: "I'm the biggest ape. Don't put me in the smallest size enclosures."
Chimpanzee: "I'm a friendly ape. I want to share the Water. with an Ape."
Gibbon: "I want to be next to the biggest ape, since I'm the smallest one. I don't like the Jungle."
Golden Lion Tamarin: "I'm a little monkey. I want to be with another little monkey."
Pygmy Marmoset: "I'm a little monkey who wants only Apes next to me. I don't like Grass."
Outrageous Orangutan: "I want to be next to exactly 3 animals in 3 enclosures."
Obvious Orangutan: "I am an ape who wants to share my space with only one ape."
